hero.title: Web design references
hero.intro: Selected client projects, outcomes, and words from working together — every one of them is live to look at.
hero.supportingNote: More projects will be added here as they are delivered. The stronger signal is how positioning, reading flow, and usability work together.

sectionIntro.title: Delivered projects with a clear focus on usefulness and outcome.
sectionIntro.description: Each project is framed as a compact case study with context, focus, concrete deliverables, and the outcome that makes the page or tool easier to use.

projects.imageAlt: Preview of the Allmacher Coaching website for the negotiation seminar in Chemnitz
projects.title: Allmacher Coaching: website for a negotiation seminar
projects.summary: A clear presence for Dr. Christoph Allmacher and his negotiation seminar in Chemnitz. Content, differentiators, and ticket options are ordered so that leaders grasp the value right away. The site is being built together right now and keeps growing.
projects.focus: Describe the seminar so that format and value are immediately clear and the inquiry becomes the obvious next step.
deliverables: seminar offer split into clear sections
trainer and method visible as trust anchors
consistent guidance toward the seminar inquiry
outcomes: makes the seminar content and format tangible at first read
puts Dr. Christoph Allmacher forward as the trainer
guides prospects to the inquiry without detours

testimonial.role: Allmacher Coaching, negotiation training in Chemnitz
testimonial.quote: I am building my website together with Moritz right now, and I am very happy with how we work together. Communication over WhatsApp is easy, direct, and fast, so questions get sorted out whenever they come up. What I value most is that Moritz takes the time to explain how things connect instead of simply working through a list. The collaboration feels relaxed and still very professional, without artificial time pressure or a purely transactional tone. My own ideas are taken seriously, developed further, and implemented reliably. I would work with Moritz again at any time and can recommend him without reservation.

projects.imageAlt: Preview of Kolja Wienigk's financial broker website with clear structure
projects.title: Financial broker website with clear positioning
projects.summary: A calm, trustworthy presence for a financial broker that makes the service offer easy to understand, establishes clear entry points, and prepares inquiries in a structured way.
projects.focus: Build trust, organise the offer clearly, and guide visitors toward the right inquiry path without friction.
outcomes: makes the offer easier to understand immediately
reduces visual noise in favour of orientation
guides inquiries into contact more clearly

testimonial.quote: From the first conversation onward, it was clear which steps made sense and what should be prioritised first. The delivery felt structured, fast, and free of unnecessary loops.

projects.imageAlt: Preview of a tool for consumption data capture
projects.title: Consumption trial for structured usage data capture
projects.summary: A focused tool that brings technical data and consumption figures into one clear interface, simplifies inputs, and makes the ongoing workflow easier to read.
projects.focus: Reduce friction in repeated inputs, surface status clearly, and turn technical data into a practical working interface.
deliverables: compact input logic with less friction
clear interface for technical consumption data
better readability across the active workflow
outcomes: makes usage data faster to interpret
brings structure to the process in one clear UI

closingCta.title: If your next project needs the same level of clarity, the next step stays short.
closingCta.supportingText: Whether it is a new website, a relaunch, or an internal tool, the strongest leverage comes from clear guidance before the first build, not louder visuals.
